title: Alas de ónix (Empíreo 3)
description: Con la guerra ya en marcha, Violet Sorrengail debe salir de Aretia para buscar aliados capaces de enfrentarse a una amenaza creciente. La tercera entrega de Empíreo pone a prueba sus vínculos, su dominio de la magia y los secretos que intenta proteger.

en.description: With war underway, Violet Sorrengail must leave Aretia to seek allies against a growing threat. The third Empyrean novel tests her relationships, her command of magic and her ability to protect secrets that could change everything.
